sort_order.description: Sort direction for the chosen sort key.

ICivicBoardRateLimit.description: Rate-limit window record mapped to Prisma model civic_board_rate_limits. This entity captures operational anti-abuse counters by logical scope (e.g., "post.create", "comment.create"), actor type ("user", "admin", "ip"), optional actor identifier, the window start/end bounds, current observed count, and the enforced limit. Timestamps support auditability and retention via soft delete. Derived from schema comments in schema-01-systematic.prisma.

id.description: Primary key (UUID).

scope.description: Logical action scope for the rate limit (e.g., "post.create", "comment.create", "report.create", "login.failed").

actor_type.description: Actor discriminator for this limit window. Allowed values: "user", "admin", "ip".

actor_id.description: Optional actor identifier (UUID) when applicable. Null for scopes like IP-based windows.

window_started_at.description: Window start timestamp (UTC) represented by this record.

window_ends_at.description: Window end timestamp (UTC) represented by this record.

count.description: Number of actions observed during the window at last update.

limit.description: Maximum allowed actions for this scope and actor during the window.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp (UTC).

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp used for retention and safe purge. Null when active.

ICivicBoardPost.IRequest.description: Search, filter, sort, and pagination parameters for listing civic_board_posts in public browsing/search endpoints. Applies AND semantics to space-separated terms over title/body (trigram indexes). Visibility rules are enforced by application logic (Published only, non-deleted). No x-autobe-prisma-schema because this type represents query parameters rather than a table mapping.

page.description: 1-based page index for offset pagination. Default 1.

limit.description: Page size. Default 20. A hard maximum of 100 is enforced to protect performance.

search.description: Keyword string with space-separated terms using AND semantics across title and body. Empty or missing means no keyword filter.

author_id.description: Optional filter to include posts authored by this user (civic_board_users.id).

published_from.description: Inclusive lower bound filter for published_at (UTC).

published_to.description: Inclusive upper bound filter for published_at (UTC).

sort_by.description: Field to sort by. Defaults to published_at when omitted.

id.description: Unique identifier of the post (UUID). Maps to civic_board_posts.id.

title.description: Post title. Business limits: 1–120 characters. Maps to civic_board_posts.title.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the post (e.g., Published, Hidden, Deleted). Maps to civic_board_posts.status.

author.description: Author user transformed from civic_board_posts.civic_board_user_id as a summary reference (no raw FK exposed).

ICivicBoardPost.ISummary.description: Post summary derived from Prisma model civic_board_posts. Optimized for list and reference contexts: includes key display fields and the author as a summary reference; excludes heavy compositions like full attachments or comments arrays.

oneOf.description: Sort direction used together with order_by in listing queries. Allowed values: asc (ascending), desc (descending).
Sort direction used together with order_by in listing queries. Allowed values: asc (ascending), desc (descending).

IESortOrder.description: Sort direction used together with order_by in listing queries. Allowed values: asc (ascending), desc (descending).

oneOf.description: Sortable fields for posts list/search endpoints. Default is published_at for newest-first ordering.
Sortable fields for posts list/search endpoints. Default is published_at for newest-first ordering.

IECivicBoardPostSortBy.description: Sortable fields for posts list/search endpoints. Default is published_at for newest-first ordering.

ICivicBoardPost.description: Post entity returned by read/update operations. Transforms the author foreign key (civic_board_user_id) into an embedded ICivicBoardUser.ISummary object. Includes optional authoring session provenance as a summary object and soft-delete timestamp to align with Prisma and sibling DTOs. Backed by Prisma model civic_board_posts.

id.description: Primary key of the post (civic_board_posts.id).

body.description: Post body, plain text with line breaks allowed (civic_board_posts.body). Limits 1–20,000 characters.

published_at.description: Publication timestamp when the post became publicly visible (civic_board_posts.published_at, UTC).

edited_at.description: Last edit timestamp within the allowed window; null if never edited (civic_board_posts.edited_at, UTC).

created_at.description: Row creation timestamp (civic_board_posts.created_at, UTC).

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention/purge policies (civic_board_posts.deleted_at, UTC). Null when active.

author.description: Author reference transformed from civic_board_user_id. Email is intentionally hidden; display_name is provided.

author_session.description: Optional authoring session context transformed to a summary object. Maps from civic_board_posts.civic_board_user_session_id and follows the BELONGS-TO → .ISummary rule; raw FK is not exposed.

title.description: Title for the new post. Stored in civic_board_posts.title. Business limits: 1–120 characters, trimmed, non-whitespace (pattern enforced).

body.description: Body text for the new post. Stored in civic_board_posts.body. Business limits: 1–20,000 characters, plain text, must contain at least one non-whitespace character (pattern enforced).

ICivicBoardPost.ICreate.description: Creation payload for a new post. Only business-editable fields are accepted. Security: The author identity (civic_board_user_id) and optional authoring session (civic_board_user_session_id) are injected from the authenticated context; clients MUST NOT provide them. Status and published_at are set by the server on success.

id.description: Primary key of the attachment record (civic_board_post_attachments.id).

civic_board_post_id.description: Identifier of the parent post (civic_board_posts.id). Kept as an ID to avoid circular expansion from the child to its parent detail (hierarchical parent FK).

uploader.description: Reference to the uploader user transformed to a summary object. Maps from civic_board_post_attachments.civic_board_user_id. This provides essential context without requiring extra round-trips.

uploader_session.description: Optional uploader session context transformed to a summary object. Maps from civic_board_post_attachments.civic_board_user_session_id. Presented as an object (or null) per BELONGS-TO → .ISummary rule; raw FK is not exposed.

uri.description: Storage URI pointing to the attached file object. Sourced from civic_board_post_attachments.uri.

original_filename.description: Sanitized user-facing original filename. Uniqueness is enforced per post by @@unique([civic_board_post_id, original_filename]). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.original_filename. Business rule: 1–120 visible characters.

content_type.description: MIME type of the attachment (e.g., image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, application/pdf). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.content_type.

byte_size.description: File size in bytes used for size-limit enforcement. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.byte_size. Non-negative.

image_width.description: Image width in pixels when the file is an image; otherwise null. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_width.

image_height.description: Image height in pixels when the file is an image; otherwise null. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_height.

created_at.description: Attachment creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.created_at.

updated_at.description: Attachment last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention/purge workflows. Null for active attachments. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.deleted_at.

ICivicBoardPostAttachment.description: Post attachment entity representing immutable file metadata tied to a post. Based on Prisma model civic_board_post_attachments. Attachments inherit visibility from the parent civic_board_posts (status: "Published" | "Hidden" | "Deleted"). This DTO transforms contextual associations (uploader and optional uploader_session) into summary objects while keeping the hierarchical parent as an ID to prevent circular expansion. All fields map to Prisma schema columns unless noted as transformed relations.

oneOf.description: Visibility status used by content models civic_board_posts.status and civic_board_comments.status. Business states: "Published" (publicly visible), "Hidden" (temporarily removed from public view), and "Deleted" (soft-deleted; retained for policy-driven purge).

Visibility status used by content models civic_board_posts.status and civic_board_comments.status. Business states: "Published" (publicly visible), "Hidden" (temporarily removed from public view), and "Deleted" (soft-deleted; retained for policy-driven purge).

Visibility status used by content models civic_board_posts.status and civic_board_comments.status. Business states: "Published" (publicly visible), "Hidden" (temporarily removed from public view), and "Deleted" (soft-deleted; retained for policy-driven purge).

IECivicBoardContentStatus.description: Visibility status used by content models civic_board_posts.status and civic_board_comments.status. Business states: "Published" (publicly visible), "Hidden" (temporarily removed from public view), and "Deleted" (soft-deleted; retained for policy-driven purge).

id.description: Primary key of the comment row (civic_board_comments.id).

civic_board_post_id.description: Hierarchical parent FK (civic_board_comments.civic_board_post_id). Kept as ID in child DTOs to avoid circular expansions.

author.description: Transformed association of civic_board_comments.civic_board_user_id to the author object. The raw FK is omitted from the DTO per FK transformation rules.

author_session.description: Optional authoring session context transformed to a summary object. Maps from civic_board_comments.civic_board_user_session_id. Provided for audit provenance; null when not captured.

body.description: Comment body text (civic_board_comments.body). Business limits: typically 1–2,000 characters; plain text only in minimal scope.

status.description: Lifecycle status (civic_board_comments.status). Expected values: Published, Hidden, Deleted.

published_at.description: UTC timestamp when the comment became visible (civic_board_comments.published_at).

edited_at.description: UTC timestamp of the last edit within the allowed window, or null if never edited (civic_board_comments.edited_at).

created_at.description: Record creation time in UTC (civic_board_comments.created_at).

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention/purge policies (civic_board_comments.deleted_at). Null when active.

ICivicBoardComment.description: Detailed comment DTO mapped to Prisma model civic_board_comments. Follows relation rules: author FK is presented as a summary object; hierarchical parent is preserved as ID to prevent circular references. Now includes optional author_session provenance for audit context. Attachments are not supported for comments in the minimal scope.

id.description: Primary key of the post (civic_board_posts.id).

edited_at.description: Last edit timestamp within the allowed window; null if never edited (civic_board_posts.edited_at, UTC).

created_at.description: Row creation timestamp (civic_board_posts.created_at, UTC).

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp for retention/purge workflows (civic_board_posts.deleted_at). Null when active.

civic_board_user_session_id.description: Optional authoring session identifier captured for audit context (civic_board_posts.civic_board_user_session_id). Nullable and may be null when session context is not retained.

author.description: Author of the post transformed from civic_board_user_id (civic_board_users).

attachments.description: All file attachments associated with this post (civic_board_post_attachments), inheriting visibility from the parent post.

comments.description: Plain-text comments associated with this post (civic_board_comments). Typically returned oldest-first for display.

reactions_count.description: Computed count of active reactions (single-like) for this post derived from civic_board_post_reactions where deleted_at IS NULL. Not stored in civic_board_posts.

ICivicBoardPostComplete.description: Complete composition view of a post for single-entity detail pages. Combines core post fields from civic_board_posts with author summary, all attachments, and comments (oldest-first). Includes optional computed aggregates such as reactions_count and now includes soft-delete and session provenance fields for audit completeness.

title.description: Updated title within 1–120 characters. Must contain at least one non‑whitespace character (pattern enforced). Ownership and edit‑window checks apply. System sets edited_at on success.

body.description: Updated body within 1–20,000 characters, plain text. Must contain at least one non‑whitespace character (pattern enforced). Ownership and edit‑window checks apply.

ICivicBoardPost.IUpdate.description: Request DTO for updating an existing post’s editable fields. Only business‑editable properties are allowed. Actor identity (user) comes from authentication context; id and status are immutable here. Prisma mapping: civic_board_posts. All fields optional; include only those being changed.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 when omitted.

limit.description: Page size (items per page). Defaults to 20; capped to protect performance.

search.description: Keyword search applied to comment body using AND semantics over space-separated terms. Matches align with trigram index on civic_board_comments.body.

author_id.description: Filter comments authored by a specific user (civic_board_users.id). This filter is optional and applicable for public/admin reads as allowed by policy.

created_from.description: Filter lower bound (inclusive) for creation time (civic_board_comments.created_at).

created_to.description: Filter upper bound (inclusive) for creation time (civic_board_comments.created_at).

published_from.description: Filter lower bound (inclusive) for published time (civic_board_comments.published_at).

published_to.description: Filter upper bound (inclusive) for published time (civic_board_comments.published_at).

Field to sort by. The default for comment listings under a post is oldest-first by created_at.
Field to sort by. The default for comment listings under a post is oldest-first by created_at.

sort_order.description: Sort direction for the chosen sort_by field. Defaults to asc (oldest-first) for comments under a post.

ICivicBoardComment.IRequest.description: Request parameters for listing/searching comments under a specific post scope. Do NOT include the post identifier here; it is provided via the path parameter. Backed by civic_board_comments (Prisma) for filtering by author, creation/published windows, and text search. Renamed to use sort_order for consistency with other list DTOs; defaults are provided to mirror documented behavior.

IECivicBoardCommentStatus.description: Canonical comment status enum alias used throughout comment DTOs. Maps to Prisma column civic_board_comments.status. Allowed values mirror IECivicBoardContentStatus: "Published", "Hidden", "Deleted". Prefer this alias for comments; IECivicBoardCommentStatus is deprecated but equivalent and should be migrated away from over time.

body.description: Plain‑text content of the comment. Business rules require 1–2,000 characters and at least one non‑whitespace character. Line breaks are allowed. Maps to civic_board_comments.body.

ICivicBoardComment.ICreate.description: Request DTO to create a new comment under a specific post using civic_board_comments. The parent post is provided by the path parameter and mapped to civic_board_comments.civic_board_post_id. Identity fields (civic_board_user_id) and session (civic_board_user_session_id) are injected from authentication context. This DTO disallows additional properties to prevent overposting. On success, status is set to "Published" and published_at is set by the backend.

body.description: Updated plain-text content. Must be 1–2,000 characters with at least one non‑whitespace character. Maps to civic_board_comments.body. Edits are only allowed within the defined time window; backend enforces the window and ownership.

ICivicBoardComment.IUpdate.description: Request DTO to update an existing comment in civic_board_comments. Only mutable business fields are allowed. Do not include identifiers (id, civic_board_post_id, civic_board_user_id) or system fields (status, published_at, edited_at, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at). Backend sets edited_at on success and preserves existing status. Path parameters {postId} and {commentId} scope the target and MUST NOT be duplicated in the body.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page. The provider may enforce an upper bound by policy.

oneOf.description: Sort key to order results. Keys map to civic_board_post_attachments columns.
Sort key to order results. Keys map to civic_board_post_attachments columns.

order_direction.description: Sort direction corresponding to order_by. Uses the canonical IESortOrder ("asc" | "desc").

content_types.description: Filter list of allowed MIME types (e.g., image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, application/pdf).

byte_size_min.description: Lower bound for civic_board_post_attachments.byte_size in bytes (inclusive).

byte_size_max.description: Upper bound for civic_board_post_attachments.byte_size in bytes (inclusive).

ICivicBoardPostAttachment.IRequest.description: Search, filter, sorting, and pagination parameters for listing attachments under a specific post context provided by the path parameter. Do NOT include the post identifier in this DTO to avoid duplicating the path parameter. Supports filtering by content_type, filename substring, byte_size ranges, optional image dimension bounds, and created_at intervals, with stable ordering.

uri.description: Storage URI to the attached file object. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.uri with a maximum length of 80,000 characters (VarChar(80000) in Prisma).

original_filename.description: User-facing original filename after sanitization (1–120 visible characters). Must be unique per post by @@unique([civic_board_post_id, original_filename]). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.original_filename.

content_type.description: Detected/accepted MIME type. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.content_type. Allowed types per product rules are defined by IECivicBoardAttachmentContentType.

byte_size.description: File size in bytes. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.byte_size. Application enforces per-file and per-post limits.

image_width.description: Image width in pixels when the attachment is an image; null or omit for non-image types. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_width (nullable).

image_height.description: Image height in pixels when the attachment is an image; null or omit for non-image types. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_height (nullable).

ICivicBoardPostAttachment.ICreate.description: Request body for creating a post attachment record. This DTO maps to Prisma model civic_board_post_attachments and includes only business-editable file metadata. Security: uploader identity (civic_board_user_id) and session (civic_board_user_session_id) come from authentication context; parent post identifier (civic_board_post_id) is provided via the path parameter and MUST NOT be duplicated here. System timestamps and IDs are system-managed and excluded.

uri.description: Updated storage URI pointing to the file object (max length 80,000 characters to match civic_board_post_attachments.uri).

original_filename.description: Updated sanitized display filename (1–120 visible characters). Must remain unique per post due to @@unique([civic_board_post_id, original_filename]). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.original_filename.

content_type.description: Updated MIME type when the underlying file changes. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.content_type. Allowed values per product rules are defined by IECivicBoardAttachmentContentType.

byte_size.description: Updated file size in bytes when the underlying file changes. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.byte_size.

image_width.description: Updated image width in pixels (for image types). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_width.

image_height.description: Updated image height in pixels (for image types). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_height.

ICivicBoardPostAttachment.IUpdate.description: Request body for updating a post attachment record. All fields are optional (partial update). Ownership and edit-window rules are enforced by service logic. Parent linkage (civic_board_post_id) and uploader fields are immutable here and excluded from this DTO. Do NOT include path parameters {postId} or {attachmentId} in the body; they are provided via the URL. System-managed fields (id, created_at, updated_at, deleted_at) are not accepted.

ICivicBoardReport.description: Administrator-facing report detail mapped to Prisma model civic_board_reports. Includes base columns (id, reason, optional note, status, created_at/updated_at, optional deleted_at) and composes exactly one specialization via report_of_post or report_of_comment. Optionally includes a moderation_action summary when the report has been resolved.

id.description: Primary key of the specialization row (UUID).

civic_board_report_id.description: Parent report identifier (civic_board_reports.id). Kept as raw ID to avoid circular expansion with the parent entity.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC) for this specialization link.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC) for this specialization link.

report.description: Base report context transformed from civic_board_report_id. Provides reason/status and other base metadata without requiring an additional fetch.

post.description: Summary of the target post (association). Transformed from civic_board_post_id; raw FK removed.

reporter.description: Summary of the reporting user (association). Transformed from civic_board_user_id; raw FK removed.

reporter_session.description: Summary of the reporting session (association). Transformed from civic_board_user_session_id; raw FK removed.

ICivicBoardReportOfPost.description: Specialization entity mapped to civic_board_report_of_posts. Binds a base report to a specific post and carries reporter identity/session context. Contextual belongs-to relations are represented as objects (report, post, reporter, reporter_session); the hierarchical parent ID (civic_board_report_id) is also included for routing while avoiding circular expansion.

reason.description: Categorical reason selected by the reporter. Persisted in civic_board_reports.reason. Required.

note.description: Optional short note up to 500 characters providing additional context. Maps to civic_board_reports.note (nullable).

ICivicBoardReportOfPost.ICreate.description:
Request body for creating a new post report. Accepts only reporter-provided business fields. Security-critical fields are excluded from the body: reporter identity (civic_board_user_id), reporter session (civic_board_user_session_id), and target post identifier are provided by authentication context and the path parameter ({postId}) respectively. The main report row is created in civic_board_reports using these fields and then specialized in civic_board_report_of_posts.

Behavioral notes:
- Duplicate prevention: The specialization enforces @@unique([civic_board_user_id, civic_board_post_id]), preventing the same user from reporting the same post more than once.
- Workflow: The server controls the report workflow state (civic_board_reports.status, e.g., initialized to "pending"); clients do not supply status.

id.description: Unique identifier of the comment (UUID). Maps to civic_board_comments.id.

civic_board_post_id.description: Hierarchical parent FK (civic_board_comments.civic_board_post_id). Kept as ID in summary to avoid circular expansion while enabling routing/linking when shown outside post context.

body.description: Comment body text (plain). Business limits: 1–2,000 characters. Maps to civic_board_comments.body.

status.description: Lifecycle status of the comment. Expected values: Published, Hidden, Deleted. Maps to civic_board_comments.status.

published_at.description: Timestamp when the comment became publicly visible (UTC). Maps to civic_board_comments.published_at.

author.description: Author user transformed from civic_board_comments.civic_board_user_id as a summary reference.

ICivicBoardComment.ISummary.description: Comment summary derived from Prisma model civic_board_comments. Provides essential fields, the author summary, and the hierarchical parent ID (civic_board_post_id) to aid routing when embedded outside the post context. Uses IECivicBoardCommentStatus for status to ensure cross-variant consistency.

id.description: Primary key of the report record. Maps to civic_board_reports.id.

reason.description: Reporter-selected reason category. Maps to civic_board_reports.reason.

note.description: Optional reporter note up to 500 characters per business rules. Maps to civic_board_reports.note; may be null.

status.description: Workflow status of this report (e.g., pending, resolved). Maps to civic_board_reports.status. Restricted to IECivicBoardReportStatus values for consistency.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the report was created. Maps to civic_board_reports.created_at.

ICivicBoardReport.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a report used for moderation queues and references. Maps to civic_board_reports and includes only essential metadata. Target bindings (post/comment) are resolved via specialization tables and not included here.

reason.description: Categorical reason for reporting the comment. Stored in civic_board_reports.reason (String).

note.description: Optional explanatory note provided by the reporter, up to 500 characters by policy. Maps to civic_board_reports.note (nullable String).

ICivicBoardReportOfComment.ICreate.description: Request body to create a moderation report targeting a specific comment. Only includes reporter-provided business fields. Security notes: user identity (civic_board_user_id) and session (civic_board_user_session_id) are injected from the authenticated context; clients MUST NOT provide them. Path parameter {commentId} supplies the target and MUST NOT be duplicated in the body. On creation, the service persists one civic_board_reports row and one civic_board_report_of_comments row linking to the target comment.

id.description: Primary key of the specialization row (UUID).

civic_board_report_id.description: Parent report identifier (civic_board_reports.id). Kept as a raw ID to avoid circular expansion with the base report.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC) for this specialization link.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC) for this specialization link.

comment.description: Summary of the target comment (association), transformed from civic_board_comment_id (FK eliminated).

reporter.description: Summary of the reporting user (association), transformed from civic_board_user_id (FK eliminated).

reporter_session.description: Summary of the reporting session (association), transformed from civic_board_user_session_id (FK eliminated).

ICivicBoardReportOfComment.description:
Specialization entity mapped to civic_board_report_of_comments. Binds a base report to a specific comment and carries reporter identity/session context.

Foreign key transformation: contextual belongs-to relations are returned as objects (comment, reporter, reporter_session) and their raw FK fields are removed from this DTO to prevent duplication and ambiguity. The hierarchical parent FK (civic_board_report_id) is kept as an ID to avoid circular references with the base report.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Defaults to 1 if not provided.

limit.description: Page size for pagination. Reasonable upper bound is enforced (e.g., 100).

oneOf.description: Sorting field applied to civic_board_reports records. Only columns that actually exist on the table are permitted.
Sorting field applied to civic_board_reports records. Only columns that actually exist on the table are permitted.

order_by.description: Sorting field applied to civic_board_reports records. Only columns that actually exist on the table are permitted.

order_direction.description: Sort direction for ordering results. Newest-first corresponds to created_at desc by default.

status.description: Workflow status filter stored in civic_board_reports.status (e.g., "pending", "resolved").

reason.description: Categorical reason filter stored in civic_board_reports.reason (e.g., "Spam", "Harassment", "Off-topic", "Other", "Misinformation").

created_at_from.description: Lower bound (inclusive) for created_at filter on civic_board_reports.

created_at_to.description: Upper bound (inclusive) for created_at filter on civic_board_reports.

include_deleted.description: Whether to include soft-deleted report rows (civic_board_reports.deleted_at IS NOT NULL). Default is false.

target_type.description: Optional specialization target filter derived via 1:1 specialization tables (civic_board_report_of_posts / civic_board_report_of_comments).

note_search.description: Substring search applied to civic_board_reports.note. Implementations typically use trigram/ILIKE search with safe bounds.

include_specialization.description: Whether server should populate specialization context (post/comment) in responses for admin views. When true, provider may join the specialization tables.

include_moderation_action.description: When true, provider may join civic_board_moderation_actions to include decision context in responses.

ICivicBoardReport.IRequest.description:
Search, filter, and sorting parameters for administrator report listings and analytics. Filters target only columns that exist on civic_board_reports (reason, status, created_at). Optional flags indicate that the server may enrich responses with specialization context or linked moderation action summary for admin UIs.

This DTO does not map to a Prisma model table directly (query intent only). Canonical enums are referenced to ensure cross-DTO consistency.

id.description: Primary key of the moderation action (UUID). Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.id.

decision.description: Resolution outcome string recorded by administrators (e.g., "No Action", "Hide", or "Delete"). Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.decision.

outcome_note.description: Optional moderator note providing rationale for the decision. Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.outcome_note. May be null when not provided.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC) when the moderation action was recorded. Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC) for this moderation action record. Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC) for administrative withdrawal/retention workflows. Null when active. Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.deleted_at.

report.description: The report that this moderation action resolves. Transformed association of civic_board_moderation_actions.civic_board_report_id to an object reference.

admin.description: Administrator who took the action. Transformed association of civic_board_moderation_actions.civic_board_admin_id to an object reference.

admin_session.description: Administrator session context at the time of action creation. Transformed association of civic_board_moderation_actions.civic_board_admin_session_id to an object reference.

ICivicBoardModerationAction.description: Moderation action entity recorded in civic_board_moderation_actions. This is the immutable audit trail for a resolved civic_board_reports item and captures the acting admin and session, the decision string, an optional outcome note, and audit timestamps. Foreign keys are represented as reference objects (Report/Admin/AdminSession) rather than raw IDs for atomic reads. Derived from Prisma schema comments under @namespace Moderation.

id.description: Primary key of the administrator session (UUID). Maps to civic_board_admin_sessions.id.

admin.description: Administrator who owns this session. Transformed association of civic_board_admin_sessions.civic_board_admin_id.

ip.description: IP address observed when the administrator session was established. Maps to civic_board_admin_sessions.ip.

href.description: Connection URL that initiated the admin session. Maps to civic_board_admin_sessions.href.

referrer.description: Referrer URL captured at session creation. May be an empty string for direct access. Maps to civic_board_admin_sessions.referrer.

created_at.description: Session creation time (UTC). Maps to civic_board_admin_sessions.created_at.

expired_at.description: Session expiration/end time (UTC), when applicable. Maps to civic_board_admin_sessions.expired_at.

ICivicBoardAdminSession.ISummary.description: Summary view of an administrator session from civic_board_admin_sessions for embedding as provenance in moderation action responses. Belongs-to admin reference is included as .ISummary to prevent circular expansion.

decision.description: Required decision to resolve the report. Allowed values reflect product policy (e.g., "No Action", "Hide", "Delete").

outcome_note.description: Optional moderator note explaining rationale. Persisted to civic_board_moderation_actions.outcome_note when provided.

ICivicBoardModerationAction.ICreate.description: Request DTO to create a moderation action for a specific report. SECURITY: Do NOT include admin identity or session IDs (derived from authenticated admin). Do NOT include civic_board_report_id in the body because it is provided as a path parameter. Fields map to Prisma civic_board_moderation_actions (decision required; outcome_note optional).

page.description: 1-based page index for pagination. Applied at query time; does not map to a Prisma column.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page (admin UIs typically use 20). Applied at query time; does not map to a Prisma column.

decision.description: Filter by moderation decision stored in civic_board_moderation_actions.decision. See Prisma comment: resolution outcomes include "No Action", "Hide", and "Delete".

report_id.description: Filter by the resolved report identifier (civic_board_moderation_actions.civic_board_report_id).

admin_id.description: Filter by the acting administrator identifier (civic_board_moderation_actions.civic_board_admin_id).

admin_session_id.description: Filter by the administrator session identifier (civic_board_moderation_actions.civic_board_admin_session_id).

include_deleted.description: Include soft-deleted records (where civic_board_moderation_actions.deleted_at IS NOT NULL) when true. Default is to exclude.

order_by.description: Sortable column for the list, typically created_at (default) or updated_at.

order.description: Sort direction to apply with order_by. Admin history views commonly use desc for newest-first.

ICivicBoardModerationAction.IRequest.description: Search, filter, sorting, and pagination parameters for listing moderation resolutions from Prisma table civic_board_moderation_actions. This DTO is used by admin-only endpoints and contains no identity fields; actor identity comes from admin authentication context. Supports created_at and updated_at window filters (inclusive UTC bounds), decision filtering, report/admin identifiers, inclusion of soft-deleted rows, and ordering by created_at or updated_at.

ICivicBoardPostReaction.ICreate.description: Request body for creating or re-activating a post reaction (civic_board_post_reactions). No fields are accepted: the target post comes from the path parameter, and the reacting user is taken from authentication context. Actor and path identifiers are intentionally excluded from the body.

id.description: Unique identifier of the post reaction record (UUID). Maps to civic_board_post_reactions.id.

user.description: Reacting user represented as a lightweight summary. Transforms civic_board_post_reactions.civic_board_user_id FK into an object for response readability.

post.description: Target post represented as a lightweight summary. Transforms civic_board_post_reactions.civic_board_post_id FK into an object to avoid N+1 lookups.

created_at.description: Timestamp when the reaction was first created (Like on). Maps to civic_board_post_reactions.created_at (UTC).

updated_at.description: Timestamp of last update including toggle operations. Maps to civic_board_post_reactions.updated_at (UTC).

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp used to represent Like off (inactive) while preserving history. NULL indicates the reaction is currently active. Maps to civic_board_post_reactions.deleted_at (UTC).

ICivicBoardPostReaction.description: Post reaction entity based on civic_board_post_reactions. Represents a single-like toggle per (user, post) pair using soft deletion semantics (deleted_at). Foreign keys civic_board_user_id and civic_board_post_id are exposed as summary objects to prevent N+1 calls and follow the BELONGS-TO → .ISummary transformation rule.

ICivicBoardCommentReaction.ICreate.description: Request body to toggle-on (create or restore) a single-like reaction on a comment. No identifiers are accepted in the body: the reacting user comes from authentication (session/JWT) and the target comment from the path parameter. The underlying Prisma model is civic_board_comment_reactions; server sets civic_board_user_id and civic_board_comment_id from context.

id.description: Primary key of the reaction row (UUID). Maps to civic_board_comment_reactions.id in Prisma.

user.description: Reacting actor transformed to an object reference (belongs-to). Derived from civic_board_comment_reactions.civic_board_user_id which references civic_board_users. Excluded raw FK per FK transformation rule.

comment.description: Target comment transformed to an object reference (belongs-to). Derived from civic_board_comment_reactions.civic_board_comment_id which references civic_board_comments. Excluded raw FK per FK transformation rule.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC) when the reaction was first added (Like on). Maps to civic_board_comment_reactions.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC), including toggling operations. Maps to civic_board_comment_reactions.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC) representing Like-off toggle. NULL means the reaction is currently active. Maps to civic_board_comment_reactions.deleted_at.

ICivicBoardCommentReaction.description: Single-like reaction on a comment. Backed by civic_board_comment_reactions (Prisma). A row represents at most one (user, comment) pair via a composite uniqueness constraint and uses deleted_at for toggle semantics. Associations are transformed to objects for read DTOs: user (ICivicBoardUser.ISummary) and comment (ICivicBoardComment.ISummary).

civic_board_post_id.description: UUID of the target post whose reactions are being counted. Matches civic_board_posts.id. Included for clarity in read responses; source is the path parameter.

count.description: Number of active reactions (deleted_at IS NULL) for the target post, aggregated from civic_board_post_reactions.

ICivicBoardPostReactionCount.description: Aggregate view reporting the number of active reactions for a post. Computed by counting rows in civic_board_post_reactions where civic_board_post_id equals the requested identifier and deleted_at IS NULL. Providers should respect post visibility per civic_board_posts.status; if the post is not available to the caller, follow the service’s exception handling rules. When reactions are globally disabled or disallowed on posts by civic_board_reaction_policies, the result should effectively be 0 while still returning a successful response. This DTO does not map directly to a Prisma model.

civic_board_comment_id.description: UUID of the target comment whose reactions are being counted. Matches civic_board_comments.id. Included for clarity in read responses; source is the path parameter.

count.description: Total number of active reactions (single-like toggles) for the target comment. This is computed by counting rows in civic_board_comment_reactions where civic_board_comment_id equals the requested comment and deleted_at IS NULL. When reactions are globally disabled or disallowed on comments by civic_board_reaction_policies, providers should return 0 while still succeeding.

ICivicBoardCommentReactionCount.description: Count result for active reactions on a comment. This DTO is a computed response and does not directly map to a Prisma model. It aggregates civic_board_comment_reactions respecting comment/post visibility (civic_board_comments.status and parent civic_board_posts.status). No personal data is included.

id.description: Primary key of the reaction policy record. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.id (UUID).

code.description: Unique business identifier for this reaction policy (e.g., "default"). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.code and must be unique.

enabled.description: Whether reactions feature is globally enabled. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.enabled.

allow_on_posts.description: Whether reactions are permitted on posts. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_posts.

allow_on_comments.description: Whether reactions are permitted on comments. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_comments.

allow_self_like.description: Whether self-like is permitted. Product rules typically keep this disabled. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_self_like.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day.description: Optional cap on number of reactions a single user may add per calendar day. NULL means unlimited. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.max_reactions_per_user_per_day.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.updated_at.

deleted_at.description: Soft deletion timestamp (UTC) for deprecated or replaced policies. NULL means active. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.deleted_at.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.description:
Reaction policy configuration entity representing global reactions behavior and guardrails. Backed by Prisma model civic_board_reaction_policies.

This record stores a unique policy code along with boolean feature switches and an optional per-user daily cap. Application logic reads these values to determine if reactions are allowed on posts/comments, whether self-like is permitted, and whether a per-user cap applies. Timestamps provide auditability. No counters are denormalized here; it strictly holds configuration.

page.description: 1-based page index for pagination. Defaults are normalized server-side when omitted or invalid.

limit.description: Maximum number of items per page. Invalid or missing values are normalized to safe defaults by the service.

oneOf.description: Sort by record creation time (UTC).
Sort by record last update time (UTC).
Sort by unique reaction policy code.

order_by.description: Field to sort by for the reaction policies listing.

oneOf.description: Ascending sort order.
Descending sort order.

order.description: Sort direction for the chosen order_by field.

code.description: Filter by exact policy code (globally unique).

code_contains.description: Substring match filter for policy code (case/locale handling is implementation-defined).

enabled.description: Filter by global reactions enablement flag.

allow_on_posts.description: Filter by whether reactions are permitted on posts.

allow_on_comments.description: Filter by whether reactions are permitted on comments.

allow_self_like.description: Filter by whether self-like is permitted.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day_min.description: Lower bound filter (inclusive) for max_reactions_per_user_per_day. Interpreted only when the target column is not null.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day_max.description: Upper bound filter (inclusive) for max_reactions_per_user_per_day. Interpreted only when the target column is not null.

created_at_from.description: Filter: include records with created_at >= this UTC timestamp.

created_at_to.description: Filter: include records with created_at <= this UTC timestamp.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.IRequest.description: Request schema for listing, searching, sorting, and paginating reaction policies from civic_board_reaction_policies. Aligns naming with other list DTOs using `limit` for page size and `order` for sort direction. Supports sorting by created_at, updated_at, or code. Unless otherwise authorized, records with deleted_at not null are excluded server-side.

code.description: Unique policy code identifier (e.g., "default"). Must be globally unique across reaction policies. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.code.

enabled.description: Whether reactions feature is globally enabled upon creation. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.enabled.

allow_on_posts.description: Allow reactions on posts. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_posts.

allow_on_comments.description: Allow reactions on comments. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_comments.

allow_self_like.description: Allow self-like. Typically false by product policy. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_self_like.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day.description: Optional per-user daily cap on reactions. Provide a non-negative integer to enforce a limit or null to indicate unlimited. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.max_reactions_per_user_per_day.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.ICreate.description: Create DTO for reaction policies. Only business-editable fields are accepted. System-managed columns such as id, created_at, updated_at, and deleted_at are excluded. Actor/admin identity is taken from authorization context, not the body.

enabled.description: Toggle global reactions enablement. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.enabled.

allow_on_posts.description: Toggle whether reactions are allowed on posts. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_posts.

allow_on_comments.description: Toggle whether reactions are allowed on comments. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_comments.

allow_self_like.description: Toggle whether self-like is allowed. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_self_like.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day.description: Set or clear per-user daily cap. Provide a non-negative integer to enforce a limit or null to remove the cap. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.max_reactions_per_user_per_day.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.IUpdate.description: Update DTO for reaction policies addressed by unique policy code in the path parameter. All fields are optional to support partial updates. Do not include the policy code here to avoid duplicating the path parameter; the server resolves the target by code from the URL.

generated_at.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this summary was computed.

items.description: Aggregated counts grouped by civic_board_reports.reason. Rows with deleted_at set are excluded from aggregation to reflect retained report data.

ICivicBoardReportStatisticsByReason.description: System-wide summary of report counts by reason. Computed from civic_board_reports via GROUP BY reason and filtered to exclude soft-deleted rows (deleted_at IS NULL).

reason.description: Reporter-selected categorical reason stored in civic_board_reports.reason. Constrained to recognized values (Spam, Harassment, Misinformation, Off-topic, Other).

count.description: Number of civic_board_reports rows for this reason where deleted_at IS NULL (soft-deleted rows excluded).

ICivicBoardReportStatisticsByReason.IIte.description: One entry of aggregated report counts for a specific reason value, computed from civic_board_reports while excluding soft-deleted rows.

generated_at.description: Timestamp (UTC) when this time series snapshot was generated. Provided to align with other analytics DTOs and to aid caching and audit contexts.

data.description: Array of per-day report counts derived from civic_board_reports.created_at truncated to the UTC calendar day. Rows where deleted_at IS NOT NULL are excluded. The series may be sparse (days with zero reports can be omitted). Unless otherwise specified by the endpoint, items are ordered by day descending (newest first).

ICivicBoardReportStatisticsByDay.description: Daily time series of report volumes for administrative trend analysis. Each element represents the number of rows in civic_board_reports created on a given UTC calendar day (DATE_TRUNC('day', created_at)). Excludes soft-deleted rows (deleted_at IS NULL filter). Includes a snapshot timestamp (generated_at) for temporal clarity and cross-schema consistency.

day.description: UTC calendar day represented as an ISO-8601 date (YYYY-MM-DD). Computed by truncating civic_board_reports.created_at to day in UTC.

count.description: Number of reports filed on the given day. Computed as COUNT(*) over civic_board_reports grouped by the truncated day, excluding rows where deleted_at is not null.

ICivicBoardReportStatisticsByDay.IItem.description: One row of the per-day time series. Represents a single UTC day bucket and its total report count sourced from civic_board_reports.

total_count.description: Total number of reports matching the applied filters (sourced from civic_board_reports), excluding soft-deleted rows (deleted_at IS NULL).

by_reason.description: Breakdown of report volumes by categorical reason. Reasons align with business policy values stored in civic_board_reports.reason.

by_status.description: Breakdown of report volumes by workflow status (e.g., pending, resolved) based on civic_board_reports.status.

by_target_type.description: Breakdown by target type as determined by the specialization linkage: civic_board_report_of_posts (post) vs civic_board_report_of_comments (comment).

series_by_day.description: Per-day time series for the result set using civic_board_reports.created_at truncated to UTC day.

by_decision.description: Optional breakdown of resolved reports by moderator decision, derived by joining civic_board_moderation_actions on civic_board_report_id. When not applicable or no decisions exist, providers may return an empty array or omit this field.

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.description: Administrative analytics object summarizing user-submitted content reports. Aggregations are computed from civic_board_reports and, when needed, its specializations (civic_board_report_of_posts, civic_board_report_of_comments) and moderation resolutions (civic_board_moderation_actions) for decision-based breakdowns. It provides totals, categorical breakdowns (reason, status, target type, decision), and a daily time series, excluding soft-deleted rows. This DTO contains derived data only and does not map 1:1 to a single Prisma model.

reason.description: Categorical reason captured in civic_board_reports.reason. Values follow board policies (e.g., Spam, Harassment, Off-topic, Other, Misinformation).

count.description: Number of reports with the given reason in the filtered set.

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.IReasonCount.description: Count of reports grouped by a specific reason value stored in civic_board_reports.reason.

status.description: Workflow state from civic_board_reports.status (e.g., pending, resolved). Exact values depend on moderation queue policies.

count.description: Number of reports currently in the given status within the filtered set.

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.IStatusCount.description: Count of reports grouped by civic_board_reports.status.

target_type.description: Discriminator of specialization: 'post' for civic_board_report_of_posts, 'comment' for civic_board_report_of_comments.

count.description: Number of reports for the specified target type within the filtered set.

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.ITargetTypeCo.description: Count of reports grouped by the type of target entity (post vs comment) as determined by specialization tables. Aggregation is derived from civic_board_reports joined with civic_board_report_of_posts (post) or civic_board_report_of_comments (comment) and EXCLUDES soft‑deleted rows (where civic_board_reports.deleted_at IS NULL).

day.description: UTC calendar day represented as an ISO‑8601 date (YYYY‑MM‑DD). Computed via DATE_TRUNC('day', civic_board_reports.created_at) in UTC.

count.description: Number of reports on the given UTC day within the filtered set (excluding soft‑deleted rows).

ICivicBoardReportAnalytics.ITimeBucket.description: A single per‑day bucket for the analytics time series. Each bucket’s day is computed in UTC from civic_board_reports.created_at (DATE_TRUNC('day')), and the count EXCLUDES rows where civic_board_reports.deleted_at IS NOT NULL to reflect retained report data.

IECivicBoardReportReason.description: Alias of IECivicBoardReportReason. Use the canonical IECivicBoardReportReason for report reason validations. This alias preserves backward compatibility while eliminating duplication.

oneOf.description: Report has been filed and is awaiting administrative review/decision.
Report has been resolved (e.g., decision recorded in civic_board_moderation_actions).

IECivicBoardReportStatus.description: Enumeration of moderation queue states reflected in Prisma column civic_board_reports.status. Minimal scope supports exactly two states: "pending" and "resolved". Use this enum consistently in analytics and admin views; do not introduce additional states without updating policy and Prisma schema.

oneOf.description: Target type discriminator used for analytics derived from specialization tables: 'post' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_posts; 'comment' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_comments.
Target type discriminator used for analytics derived from specialization tables: 'post' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_posts; 'comment' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_comments.

IECivicBoardReportTargetType.description: Target type discriminator used for analytics derived from specialization tables: 'post' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_posts; 'comment' corresponds to civic_board_report_of_comments.

id.description: Primary key of the configuration record. Maps to civic_board_configurations.id.

key.description: Unique configuration identifier (e.g., "public_read", "attachments.max_count"). Maps to civic_board_configurations.key and serves as the human/business lookup key.

value_string.description: String value variant used when this configuration is expressed as text. Maps to civic_board_configurations.value_string. Only one typed value field is expected to be populated per row.

value_int.description: Integer value variant used for numeric limits. Maps to civic_board_configurations.value_int.

value_double.description: Decimal value variant used for thresholds/ratios with fractional precision. Maps to civic_board_configurations.value_double.

value_boolean.description: Boolean value variant used for feature toggles. Maps to civic_board_configurations.value_boolean.

value_uri.description: URI value variant used for endpoints or callback URLs. Maps to civic_board_configurations.value_uri.

description.description: Human-readable explanation of the configuration purpose and usage. Maps to civic_board_configurations.description.

effective_since.description: Optional timestamp indicating when this configuration became effective (UTC). Maps to civic_board_configurations.effective_since.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_configurations.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_configurations.updated_at.

ICivicBoardConfiguration.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a system-wide configuration entry from civic_board_configurations. This type is optimized for list and reference contexts and contains the identifier, the configuration key, and its typed value fields.

It reflects the design of the Prisma model where a configuration is stored as an independent key-value record with multiple typed columns (value_string, value_int, value_double, value_boolean, value_uri). Only one typed value column is typically populated for a single row. No foreign keys exist for this table as configurations are intentionally decoupled from domain content and identities.

id.description: Primary key of the policy record. Maps to civic_board_policies.id.

policy_code.description: Stable policy identifier (e.g., "public_read", "attachments.policy"). Unique across the system. Maps to civic_board_policies.policy_code.

name.description: Human-friendly policy name for administrative UIs. Maps to civic_board_policies.name.

category.description: Optional category for grouping related policies (e.g., "visibility", "attachments"). Maps to civic_board_policies.category.

enabled.description: Whether the policy is currently enabled. For value-carrying policies, this indicates if enforcement is active. Maps to civic_board_policies.enabled.

value_string.description: Optional textual value governed by the policy. Maps to civic_board_policies.value_string.

value_int.description: Optional integer value (e.g., numeric limits). Maps to civic_board_policies.value_int.

value_double.description: Optional decimal value (e.g., MB limits with fractional precision). Maps to civic_board_policies.value_double.

starts_at.description: Optional start of the policy’s effective window (UTC). Maps to civic_board_policies.starts_at.

ends_at.description: Optional end of the policy’s effective window (UTC). Maps to civic_board_policies.ends_at.

notes.description: Administrative notes describing policy rationale or change context (not shown to end users). Maps to civic_board_policies.notes.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_policies.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_policies.updated_at.

ICivicBoardPolicy.ISummary.description:
Summary view of a system policy from civic_board_policies. Optimized for listing and embedding in other responses, it exposes the identity, primary code, on/off state, and optional effective window and values.

This mirrors the Prisma model where each policy is an independently managed record with optional typed value columns and an effective period (starts_at/ends_at). Policies are used by application logic to enforce behaviors such as public-read, attachment constraints, and reporting limits.

id.description: Primary key of the audit log entry. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.id.

actor_type.description: Type of actor that initiated the event. Allowed values: "user", "admin", "system". Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.actor_type.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor when applicable. Nullable. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.actor_id.

actor_session_id.description: Identifier of the actor session when applicable. Nullable. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.actor_session_id.

action.description: Business action name (e.g., "post.create", "comment.delete", "policy.update"). Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.action.

target_table.description: Target table name when the action is scoped to a resource (e.g., "civic_board_posts"). Nullable. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.target_table.

target_id.description: Target resource identifier when applicable. Nullable. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.target_id.

ip.description: IP address observed for the request context. Nullable. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.ip.

href.description: Full request URL at the time of the event. Nullable. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.href.

referrer.description: Referrer URL captured with the event. Nullable. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.referrer.

message.description: Optional human-readable message or error context aiding investigations. Nullable. Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.message.

created_at.description: Event creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_audit_logs.created_at.

ICivicBoardAuditLog.ISummary.description:
Audit log summary DTO for list views and embeddings. Represents append-only security/compliance events recorded by the system. Based on Prisma model civic_board_audit_logs.

This summary focuses on identification, actor context, action/outcome, optional target reference, and the creation time for ordering. It omits internal update/delete timestamps to keep payload minimal for list usage. Sensitive credential data is never stored here and therefore not exposed.

id.description: Primary key of the rate-limit record. Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.id.

scope.description: Logical action scope for the limit window (e.g., "post.create", "comment.create", "report.create", "login.failed"). Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.scope.

actor_type.description: Actor discriminator for this limit window. Allowed values: "user", "admin", "ip". Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.actor_type.

actor_id.description: Identifier of the actor when applicable; nullable for IP-scoped limits. Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.actor_id.

window_started_at.description: Start timestamp (UTC) of the rate limit window. Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.window_started_at.

window_ends_at.description: End timestamp (UTC) of the rate limit window. Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.window_ends_at.

count.description: Number of actions performed during the current window at update time. Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.count.

limit.description: Maximum actions allowed during the window per actor and scope. Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.limit.

created_at.description: Record creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_rate_limits.created_at.

ICivicBoardRateLimit.ISummary.description:
Rate-limit summary DTO for monitoring and admin list views. Mirrors key window metadata and counters from Prisma model civic_board_rate_limits.

Includes scope, actor context, active window bounds, and current usage vs limit to enable quick assessment. Nullable actor_id supports IP or anonymous scopes. Update/delete audit fields are intentionally omitted in summary for compactness.

id.description: Unique identifier of the post attachment (UUID). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.id.

civic_board_post_id.description: Hierarchical parent identifier of the owning post (UUID). Kept as ID to avoid circular references when attachments are embedded under a post. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.civic_board_post_id.

uri.description: Storage URI pointing to the attached file object. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.uri.

original_filename.description: User-facing original filename (sanitized). Must be unique per post. Business rule: 1–120 visible characters. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.original_filename.

content_type.description: MIME type constrained to the allowed set (image/jpeg, image/png, image/gif, application/pdf). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.content_type.

byte_size.description: File size in bytes, used to enforce per-file and per-post limits. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.byte_size.

image_width.description: Image width in pixels for image types; null for non-image attachments. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_width.

image_height.description: Image height in pixels for image types; null for non-image attachments. Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.image_height.

uploader.description: Uploader user reference transformed from civic_board_post_attachments.civic_board_user_id. Actor reference is presented as a summary object (not raw FK) per DTO rules.

created_at.description: Attachment creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.created_at.

updated_at.description: Attachment last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_post_attachments.updated_at.

ICivicBoardPostAttachment.ISummary.description: Summary representation of a Post Attachment derived from Prisma model civic_board_post_attachments. Includes essential file metadata and the uploader reference while keeping the hierarchical parent (post) as an ID to prevent circular expansion when attachments are returned as part of a post read. Visibility follows the parent post status (Published/Hidden/Deleted) per business rules.

id.description: Primary key of the moderation action record. Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.id.

decision.description: Resolution outcome selected by the moderator (e.g., Hide, Delete, or No Action). Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.decision.

outcome_note.description: Optional moderator note describing the rationale for the decision. Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.outcome_note; may be null.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp when the moderation action was recorded. Maps to civic_board_moderation_actions.created_at.

admin.description: Acting administrator who performed this moderation action. Derived from civic_board_moderation_actions.civic_board_admin_id (belongs-to reference).

report.description: The report resolved by this action. Derived from civic_board_moderation_actions.civic_board_report_id (belongs-to reference).

ICivicBoardModerationAction.ISummary.description: Summary view of a moderation action resolving a user-submitted report. This DTO maps to civic_board_moderation_actions and exposes the decision, optional note, timestamps, and key associations (admin and report). Use this lightweight form in lists or embedded contexts. Sensitive or heavy relations are excluded.

id.description: Primary key of the reaction policy. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.id.

code.description: Globally unique reaction policy code (e.g., "default"). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.code and must be unique.

enabled.description: Whether reactions feature is globally enabled. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.enabled.

allow_on_posts.description: If true, reactions are permitted on posts. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_posts.

allow_on_comments.description: If true, reactions are permitted on comments. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_on_comments.

allow_self_like.description: If true, self-like is allowed by policy; typically false. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.allow_self_like.

max_reactions_per_user_per_day.description: Optional per-user daily cap for reaction additions. Non-negative integer when present; null indicates unlimited per the policy. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.max_reactions_per_user_per_day.

created_at.description: Creation timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.created_at.

updated_at.description: Last update timestamp (UTC). Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies.updated_at.

ICivicBoardReactionPolicy.ISummary.description: Summary view of the reaction policy configuration. Maps to civic_board_reaction_policies and exposes the main toggles and optional per-user cap for list or embed contexts.

channel.description: Preferred delivery channel. For civicBoard MVP this is fixed to "email".

locale.description: Optional BCP 47 language tag for template localization (e.g., "en-US"). Used only as a hint for presentation; does not affect token issuance or validation.

href.description: Optional current page URL from which the request originates. Useful for template links or analytics.

referrer.description: Optional referrer URL captured by the client for analytics and template phrasing. May be an empty string when the admin arrives directly (no referrer).

ICivicBoardEmailVerification.IDelivery.description: Delivery hint object for administrator email verification issuance. Identity (recipient) is derived from the authenticated admin; these hints guide presentation and routing only. Values do not map directly to Prisma. Issuance writes occur in civic_board_email_verifications and link via civic_board_email_verification_of_admins.

refresh_token.description: Opaque refresh artifact issued at login that maps to an active civic_board_user_sessions row. Used to request new access credentials while session remains valid.

ICivicBoardUserSession.IRequest.description: Refresh request payload to renew access credentials for an existing authenticated member session. The server validates that the associated civic_board_user_sessions entry is active (expired_at is NULL) and that the linked civic_board_users record is still eligible (not suspended, not deleted). Session context fields (ip, href, referrer) are NOT included here because refresh reuses the existing session.

delivery.description: Optional delivery hints used by the server to orchestrate how the verification email is dispatched. The server reads the recipient from civic_board_users.email; these hints only guide presentation and routing.

ICivicBoardEmailVerificationOfUser.IRequ.description:
Request payload for issuing or re-sending an email verification token for the currently authenticated member. Used by POST /auth/user/email/verify/request.

Security: The authenticated user identity comes from the session/JWT; clients MUST NOT provide user identifiers. The backend inserts a row into civic_board_email_verifications (actor_type = "user") and links it via civic_board_email_verification_of_users to the current civic_board_users.id.

Prisma reference: civic_board_email_verifications, civic_board_email_verification_of_users.

channel.description: Preferred delivery channel. For civicBoard MVP this is fixed to "email".

locale.description: BCP 47 language tag for template localization (e.g., "en-US").

href.description: Optional current page URL from which the request originates. Useful for template links or analytics.

referrer.description: Optional referrer URL captured by the client for analytics and template phrasing. May be an empty string when the user arrives directly (no referrer).

ICivicBoardEmailVerificationOfUser.IDeli.description: Delivery hint object for verification issuance. These values are transient and do not map directly to a Prisma model; issuance writes are performed to civic_board_email_verifications and linked via civic_board_email_verification_of_users.

ICivicBoardEmailVerificationOfUser.IEDel.description:
Delivery channel options for verification communications. The minimal release supports only "email".

- email: Use civic_board_users.email to deliver the verification link.

ICivicBoardEmailVerificationOfUser.ISumm.description:
Union response type used by email verification flows. Represents either:
- Issuance acknowledgement (ICivicBoardUserEmailVerification.IIssue.ISummary) returned by POST /auth/user/email/verify/request, or
- Confirmation outcome (ICivicBoardUserEmailVerification.IConfirm.ISummary) returned by POST /auth/user/email/verify/confirm.

This union aligns the schema with operation usage while keeping each variant self-descriptive.

token.description: Opaque verification token string copied from the email link. This value maps to civic_board_email_verifications.token and is case-sensitive. The backend verifies actor_type = "user", ensures expires_at is in the future, and that used = false before consuming the token.

ICivicBoardEmailVerificationOfUser.IConf.description: Request DTO to confirm a member's email by consuming a verification token. The service will locate a row in civic_board_email_verifications (actor_type = "user", token match, not expired, not used), set used = true and used_at = now, then follow the specialization civic_board_email_verification_of_users to update the associated civic_board_users row (email_verified = true). This endpoint is public and returns generic errors to avoid disclosing account existence. No authentication or actor IDs are accepted in this body.

email.description: Member email address used to identify a civic_board_users record when issuing a password reset token. Corresponds to civic_board_users.email (unique). The backend creates a civic_board_password_reset_tokens row (actor_type = "user") and a linked civic_board_password_reset_token_of_users row when applicable. The response is uniform to avoid leaking whether the email exists.

ICivicBoardPasswordResetTokenOfUser.IReq.description: Request DTO to initiate a password reset for a member account. Accepts an email address and, if a matching civic_board_users row exists, creates a civic_board_password_reset_tokens record (actor_type = "user", token, expires_at, used = false) and a civic_board_password_reset_token_of_users link. This operation is public and rate-limitable; it must not reveal whether an account exists.

token.description: Opaque password reset token issued previously via POST /auth/user/password/reset/request. This value must match civic_board_password_reset_tokens.token for a record where actor_type = "user", expires_at is still in the future, and used = false. See Prisma model civic_board_password_reset_tokens (token, actor_type, expires_at, used).

password.description: New password in plain text supplied by the client. The backend hashes this value and stores it into civic_board_users.password_hash for the user associated through civic_board_password_reset_token_of_users. NEVER submit pre-hashed values. See Prisma model civic_board_users (password_hash).

ICivicBoardPasswordResetTokenOfUser.ICon.description: Request DTO to confirm a member password reset by consuming a civic_board_password_reset_tokens row (actor_type = "user") and updating the linked civic_board_users.password_hash. The server validates token freshness (expires_at), unused status (used = false), and association via civic_board_password_reset_token_of_users, then marks the token as used (used = true, used_at set). No authentication is required for this flow.

acknowledged.description: Indicates that the password reset flow request or confirmation was accepted for processing. For security, responses are uniform and do not disclose whether an email address or token matched any account. This is a generic acknowledgement for both issuance and confirmation steps.

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp when the issued reset token expires, when applicable to issuance responses. This property MAY be omitted when the system avoids revealing issuance details. The token value itself is never returned.

ICivicBoardPasswordResetTokenOfUser.ISum.description: Lightweight acknowledgement DTO returned by password reset endpoints for members. It intentionally avoids leaking account existence or token validity specifics. When used by the issuance endpoint, providers MAY include expires_at to communicate the token’s expiry time; confirmation typically returns only acknowledgement without exposing additional details.

email.description: Administrator email address used to locate the target civic_board_admins row and issue a password reset token. The flow inserts into civic_board_password_reset_tokens (actor_type="admin", token, expires_at, used=false) and creates the specialization row in civic_board_password_reset_token_of_admins referencing the admin. This request does not modify civic_board_admins.

ICivicBoardPasswordResetTokenOfAdmin.ICr.description: Password reset request payload for administrators. Accepts an email to provision a reset token by writing to civic_board_password_reset_tokens and binding it via civic_board_password_reset_token_of_admins. No session is established and no sensitive data is returned. Security controls such as rate limits may be enforced using civic_board_rate_limits. Note: This DTO does not correspond 1:1 to a Prisma model and therefore does not declare x-autobe-prisma-schema.

acknowledged.description: Indicates that the password reset token issuance request was accepted for processing in a privacy‑preserving manner. This acknowledgement applies to both admin and user password reset flows; it does not disclose whether an account exists.

expires_at.description: UTC timestamp when the issued reset token expires, if a token was created. Corresponds to civic_board_password_reset_tokens.expires_at. This value may be omitted when the system deliberately avoids revealing issuance details.

ICivicBoardPasswordResetToken.ISummary.description:
Password reset issuance acknowledgement DTO.

This generic summary applies to password reset token requests (admin or user). It intentionally avoids revealing whether an email/account exists. When a token is actually issued, its expiry may be provided via expires_at; the token value itself is never returned.

token.description: Opaque password reset token previously issued and stored in civic_board_password_reset_tokens.token with actor_type="admin". Must be valid (not expired, not used) and linked via civic_board_password_reset_token_of_admins to the target admin.

password.description: New password in plain text for verification and hashing on the server side (min 8, max 2000 characters to match admin join policy). The backend will hash this value and store it in civic_board_admins.password_hash. Clients must NOT send pre-hashed passwords.

ICivicBoardPasswordResetTokenOfAdminConf.description: Request body to finalize an admin password reset using a previously issued token. On success, the backend replaces civic_board_admins.password_hash, marks the token as used (used=true, used_at), and may expire existing sessions in civic_board_admin_sessions. Security: Do NOT include any admin identifiers; identity is resolved from the token specialization.

- all_except_current: Revoke every active session except the current authenticated session (current session is inferred from JWT/session).
